rationale: The stock gapped down ~6.7% at the open and has since recovered to 95.3% of today's range, sitting just $0.03 below the session high with a tiny ATR of $0.06 on 5-minute bars — the reward-to-risk ratio for a long is extremely compressed at this level. A short against the intraday trend with price pressing the high and strong relative volume (14x) supporting the recovery also lacks a clean mechanical edge. With the position already near the top of the range and no clear catalyst for a directional continuation, the risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable.
